name: 29410 · Hanahan, SC
findings: ZIP 29410 (Hanahan) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29410 (Hanahan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29410 (Hanahan) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 6% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
